description: Fleet state, tasks, workers and telemetry of horsies, from the worker endpoints and the fleet collector.

panels.description: Workers with a snapshot inside the live window (horsies_fleet_workers).
panels.title: Live workers

panels.description: Queues and execution classes with PENDING tasks and no live worker that serves them (horsies_fleet_unserved_classes).
panels.title: Unserved classes

panels.description: The longest wait of a due PENDING task over all queues (horsies_queue_oldest_pending_age_seconds).
panels.title: Oldest pending task

panels.description: Queries of the fleet collector whose last run failed or passed its time limit (horsies_exporter_collect_failed). Their gauges have no series.
panels.title: Fleet queries failing

panels.description: Live workers whose metrics endpoint or event handler child is down (horsies_fleet_workers_telemetry_down).
panels.title: Workers with telemetry down

panels.description: The newest successful migration of the database (horsies_schema_version).
panels.title: Schema version

panels.description: Age of the oldest due PENDING task, by queue and execution class. The backlog alert uses it: the queue depth is exact only up to 1,000.
panels.title: Oldest pending task age

panels.description: Live task rows by queue, execution class and status. A PENDING count past 1,000 is in "more than" instead.
panels.title: Live tasks by status

panels.description: Seats of the live workers and the seats that hold a task, by execution class.
panels.title: Fleet seats

panels.description: Live workers by slot health.
panels.title: Live workers by state

panels.description: Workflows that are not terminal, by status.
panels.title: Workflows

panels.description: A schedule that never ran has no series.
panels.title: Time since the last run of each schedule

panels.description: Time of each query of the fleet collector, and the failed runs.
panels.title: Fleet query time (p95) and failures

panels.description: Attempts that ended with a known outcome, per second.
panels.title: Attempts by outcome

panels.description: Attempts that ended FAILED or WORKER_FAILURE, as a part of all attempts of the task.

targets.expr: sum by (queue, task) (rate(horsies_task_attempts_total{outcome!="COMPLETED", queue=~"$queue", task=~"$task"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (queue, task) (rate(horsies_task_attempts_total{queue=~"$queue", task=~"$task"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Not completed ratio by task

panels.description: The 10 error codes with the most attempts that did not complete, per second.
panels.title: Not completed attempts by error code

panels.description: Attempts whose outcome write scheduled a retry, per second.
panels.title: Retries by error code

panels.description: From the placement of an attempt on a child to its end, as the worker saw it.
panels.title: Run time

panels.description: From the due time of a task to its claim.
panels.title: Queue wait (p95) by queue

panels.description: Slot wait: from the claim to the placement on a child. Outcome write: from the end of the attempt to the end of its write.
panels.title: Slot wait and outcome write (p95)

panels.description: Attempts whose child was killed before its exit was seen; recovery decides the row.
panels.title: Attempts with an unknown end

panels.description: Seats of the workers and the seats that hold a task, by execution class.
panels.title: Worker seats

panels.description: Child slots that are down, by kind.
panels.title: Child slots down

panels.description: Child processes that ended and were replaced.
panels.title: Children replaced by reason

panels.description: From the start of a child process to its ready frame.
panels.title: Child boot time (p95)

panels.description: Passes of the claim loop, per second.
panels.title: Claim passes by result

panels.description: Claimed tasks released before they ran, and attempts that stopped before the child set them RUNNING, by reason.
panels.title: Claims released and starts refused

panels.description: Resident memory of the worker parents, of the task children together, and of the handler children.
panels.title: Resident memory

panels.description: Task rows that the reaper recovered, reaper steps that failed, and outcome writes sent again.
panels.title: Recovery and outcome write retries

panels.description: One row per worker process: its id, version and profile (horsies_worker_info).
panels.title: Workers

panels.description: Lifecycle events that did not reach the handler child, by cause.
panels.title: Events dropped

panels.description: Samples dropped because their metric holds its greatest number of series, by metric.
panels.title: Samples dropped at the series bound

panels.description: Events for which a handler failed, and events that the full queue of a handler dropped.
panels.title: Event handler errors and drops
